text:
marta: Drafting RN + short internal blurb for tonight's EU canary. Need ops + legal quick ACK before I queue the blast.

marta: RN draft: "Model runtime: KV cache warmup reduces cold-start token latency by ~30% (p95). Canary will pin model v2.1.3; automatic fallback to v2.0.9 if load or errors spike. SDK: auth-header change is opt-in behind a feature flag and will not be enabled by default. Private EU customers: data processing and retention remain in-region per residency settings."

devansh: Added bullets to RN doc: expose warmup metrics (warmup_ms, warmup_hits), model pin v2.1.3 + fallback v2.0.9, perf summary, link to SDK PR.

kai: Ops proposal: rollback if error rate >1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency >1500ms for 3m. Canary plan: start 5% traffic, hold 10m, ramp to 20% if green. I'll own the ramp.

lia: Legal: please include the in-region processing line (you have it). I can sign off after that sentence is present.

devansh: Deploy command we'll execute:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02-gen --traffic 5% --notes "kv-warmup, sdk-flag"
```
Alerts -> canary-alerts@pager and #infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02-gen for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; queued by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

devansh: ACK  infra dashboards + alerts set. Will monitor error budgets and p95 panels.

kai: SGTM. I'll run the ramp at +10m if metrics stay steady and annotate with canary-checklist.

marta: Need a concise internal blurb to post ~30m before target to #eng-releases and tag @eng-oncall. Anyone volunteer?

devansh: Suggestion: "Canary rn-2026-04-02-gen: model v2.1.3 -> 5% EU, ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/devansh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors (5m) or p95 >1500ms (3m)."

kai: That's clean. I'll be on-call for the ramp.

marta: Lia, confirm legal wording OK so I can queue the announce.

lia: :thumbsup: wording OK. Legal signs off.

devansh: Ops playbook snippet (emergency fallback):
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary rollback"
```
Also include steps to toggle SDK flag off in feature-flag dashboard.

marta: Final check: all thumbs to proceed? I'll schedule the preflight ping and set deploy-bot to fire 30m before.

kai: 44d from eng.

devansh: 44d infra.

lia: Legal signed.

marta: Thanks all 680 queuing internal announce and will hit deploy-bot per schedule.
